purpose: Lightweight governed ORIGINATING-WORK lineage identifiers. A retrieval artifact (a database record, a journal PDF, an excerpt) is NOT the originating scientific work. A source record points to its originating_work_id here. Scientific INDEPENDENCE is judged on originating_work lineage: two artifacts reproducing the same work are ONE lineage; genuinely distinct works are independent. This is a minimal lineage registry, NOT a citation graph.
rules: retrieval repository != originating scientific work; different URLs/repositories != independent science.
Same originating_work_id (reached via different artifacts) => NOT independent (deduplicated for sufficiency).
related_work_ids records conservative shared-lineage (shared authors/data), also treated as NOT independent.
This registry asserts no scientific fact; it names works and their relationships only.
